title: Eddie Tompkins eats Joe's steak in Yankton
summary: With the Eli Rice band, trumpeter Eddie Tompkins followed Joe to the cook in Yankton, South Dakota, and joked he'd eat his steak because Thomas's stomach couldn't take it.
